Rice_Bacterial_Leaf_Blight.organic: Use balanced nitrogen; improve drainage; remove weed hosts; heat treat seeds (52°C for 10 min).
Rice_Bacterial_Leaf_Blight.english: Spray Copper Hydroxide or apply Streptomycin + Tetracycline combination.

Rice_Brown_Spot.organic: Improve soil potassium; use certified disease-free seeds; apply neem seed kernel extract.
Rice_Brown_Spot.english: Spray Edifenphos or Mancozeb; treat seeds with Captan or Thiram.

Rice_Healthy.organic: Maintain regular crop monitoring and continue organic composting.

Rice_Leaf_Blast.organic: Avoid excessive nitrogen; burn infected crop residues; maintain standing water in fields.
Rice_Leaf_Blast.english: Spray Tricyclazole or Carbendazim; use Azoxystrobin.

Rice_Leaf_scald.organic: Apply balanced fertilizer and space plants properly for improved airflow.
Rice_Leaf_scald.english: Spray Benomyl or Carbendazim; apply copper-based fungicides.

Rice_Sheath_Blight.organic: Remove weeds from levees; reduce planting density; apply Trichoderma harzianum.
Rice_Sheath_Blight.english: Apply Hexaconazole or Validamycin; use Trifloxystrobin + Tebuconazole.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.organic: Prune lower leaves to reduce splash; apply copper organic sprays; practice 3-year crop rotation.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.english: Spray Copper Sulfate with Mancozeb or apply Streptomycin sulfate.

Tomato___Early_blight.organic: Mulch base; remove bottom 12 inches of leaves; spray compost tea.

Tomato___Late_blight.organic: Destroy infected plant parts; improve air circulation; apply Bacillus subtilis.
Tomato___Late_blight.english: Spray Copper-based fungicides or apply Fenamidone + Mancozeb.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.organic: Reduce humidity in greenhouses; increase plant spacing; sterilize garden tools.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.organic: Remove infected leaves immediately; avoid overhead watering; control horsenettle weeds.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.english: Apply Mancozeb, Chlorothalonil, or Copper Hydroxide.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.organic: Release predatory mites; use forceful water streams; apply Insecticidal soap or Neem oil.

Tomato___Target_Spot.organic: Remove old crop debris and maintain dry foliage.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.organic: Use yellow sticky traps; cover plants with fine mesh; use reflective mulches.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.english: Apply Imidacloprid or Acetamiprid to control whitefly vectors.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.organic: Wash hands with milk/soap before handling; remove and burn infected plants.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.english: No chemical cure; use virus-resistant seeds and practice soil solarization.

Tomato___healthy.organic: Continue routine mulching and regular scouting.

Wheat___Brown_Rust.organic: Early sowing to avoid heat; use resistant cultivars; apply sulphur dust.

Wheat___Healthy.organic: Ensure proper seed depth and monitoring.

Wheat___Yellow_Rust.organic: Plant resistant varieties and eliminate 'green bridge' weeds.

corn_Blight.organic: Rotate crops with legumes and deep-plow residues.

corn_Common_Rust.organic: Plant early in the season and apply neem-based sprays.

corn_Gray_Leaf_Spot.organic: Use conventional tillage to bury debris; practice one-year crop rotation.

corn_Healthy.organic: Maintain soil health and routine monitoring.

other_leaf.english: AgriShield currently supports Rice, Tomato, Wheat, Corn, Potato, and Sugarcane.

potato_Bacteria.organic: Use certified tubers; practice crop rotation; avoid injury during harvest.
potato_Bacteria.english: Spray Copper Oxychloride or treat soil with bleaching powder.

potato_Late_Blight.organic: Remove infected tubers; spray copper fungicides; apply Bacillus subtilis.

potato_Nematode.organic: Plant marigolds; solarize soil; add high organic matter.
potato_Nematode.english: Apply Fluopyram, Ethoprophos, or fumigate soil.

potato_Pest.organic: Apply Neem oil; use Bt; hand-pick larger pests.

potato_Phytopthora.organic: Improve field drainage and use resistant cultivars.
potato_Phytopthora.english: Apply Phosphonate fungicides or spray Mefenoxam.

potato_Virus.organic: Control aphid populations; practice roguing; use virus-free tubers.
potato_Virus.english: Apply systemic insecticides for vectors or mineral oil sprays.

sugarcane_BacterialBlights.organic: Hot water treatment of setts and sterilize cutting knives.
sugarcane_BacterialBlights.english: Spray Copper Hydroxide or apply Streptomycin.

sugarcane_Mosaic.organic: Rogue out infected clumps and control weed hosts.
sugarcane_Mosaic.english: Use insecticides for aphid control or use meristem culture plants.

sugarcane_RedRot.organic: Select healthy setts; avoid ratoon crop; burn trash after harvest.
sugarcane_RedRot.english: Treat setts with Carbendazim or apply Triadimefon.

sugarcane_Rust.organic: Avoid over-irrigation and apply sulfur dust.

sugarcane_Yellow.organic: Use tissue-cultured planting material and monitor aphid vectors.
sugarcane_Yellow.english: Spray Dimethoate for aphids or apply Imidacloprid.
